source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Paul's manner and the pinned testimony reading.
key_decisions.before: I, when I came to you, brothers and sisters, did not come with superiority of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
key_decisions.after: And when I came to you, brothers and sisters, I did not come with superior speech or wisdom as I proclaimed God's testimony to you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I, when I came to you, brothers, did not come with superiority of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps maturity, present age, and doomed rulers.
key_decisions.before: Yet we speak wisdom among the mature, but not a wisdom of this age nor of the rulers of this age, who are being brought to nothing;
key_decisions.after: Yet we do speak wisdom among the mature, though not the wisdom of this age or of this age's rulers, who are passing away.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Yet we speak wisdom among the mature, but not a wisdom of this age nor of the rulers of this age, who are being brought to nothing;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves mystery, hiddenness, prior purpose, and glory.
key_decisions.before: but we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the hidden wisdom, which God predestined before the ages for our glory,
key_decisions.after: Instead, we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the hidden wisdom God determined before the ages for our glory.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the hidden wisdom, which God predestined before the ages for our glory,

key_decisions.rationale: Chooses a defensible reading of the compressed final phrase.
key_decisions.before: which things we also speak, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual things to spiritual people.
key_decisions.after: We also speak these things, not in words taught by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual things to spiritual people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: which things we also speak, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual things to spiritual people.

key_decisions.before: But the natural person does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him, and he is not able to understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
key_decisions.after: But the merely natural person does not receive the things of God's Spirit, for they are foolishness to that person, who cannot understand them because they are discerned spiritually.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the natural person does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him, and he is not able to understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the universal contrast without claiming omniscience.
key_decisions.before: But the spiritual person discerns everything, yet he himself is discerned by no one.
key_decisions.after: The spiritual person discerns all things but is himself judged by no one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the spiritual person discerns all things, yet he himself is discerned by no one.
